atoms.text: Sophie and her friends are having a sleepover. They voted on which toppings they should get on their pizzas.

instruction.text: 3 of her friends voted for mushrooms. Select the correct number of blocks on the block diagram to show how many votes mushrooms got.
5 of her friends voted for ham. Select the correct number of blocks to show how many votes ham got.

atoms.text: Sophie and her friends also voted on which film they wanted to watch at the sleepover.

instruction.text: 5 of her friends voted for Fish Friends. Select the correct number of blocks to show how many votes Fish Friends got.
3 of her friends voted for Tim’s Adventures. Select the correct number of blocks to show how many votes Tim’s Adventures got.
